targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered_states AS (
  SELECT
    ts AS started_at,
    LEAD(ts, 1, $__timeTo()) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS ended_at,
    to_state
  FROM fsm_transitions
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND fsm_name = 'vehicle'
    AND ts <= $__timeTo()
),
state_durations AS (
  SELECT
    to_state,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(ended_at, $__timeTo()) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom())
    )) / 3600.0 AS hours
  FROM ordered_states
  WHERE ended_at > $__timeFrom()
    AND started_at < $__timeTo()
)
SELECT ROUND((
  100.0 * SUM(hours) FILTER (WHERE to_state = 'asleep')
    / NULLIF(SUM(hours) FILTER (
        WHERE to_state IN ('asleep', 'online', 'offline')
      ), 0)
)::numeric, 1) AS "Sleep %"
FROM state_durations

panels.title: Sleep Efficiency Score
panels.description: Share of recorded non-driving, non-charging idle time spent in the asleep state, derived from consecutive vehicle-FSM transitions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered_transitions AS (
  SELECT
    ts,
    to_state,
    LEAD(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts
  FROM fsm_transitions
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND fsm_name = 'vehicle'
    AND ts >= $__timeFrom()
),
parked_windows AS (
  SELECT ts AS started_at, next_ts AS ended_at
  FROM ordered_transitions
  WHERE to_state = 'parked'
    AND next_ts IS NOT NULL
),
non_charging_windows AS (
  SELECT pw.started_at, pw.ended_at
  FROM parked_windows pw
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM signal_log sl
    WHERE sl.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
      AND sl.field = 'ChargeState'
      AND sl.value_kind = 7
      AND sl.ts >= pw.started_at
      AND sl.ts <= pw.ended_at
      AND sl.int_value > 1
  )
),
battery_samples AS (
  SELECT
    pw.started_at,
    pw.ended_at,
    sl.float_value AS battery_level,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pw.started_at, pw.ended_at ORDER BY sl.ts ASC
    ) AS rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pw.started_at, pw.ended_at ORDER BY sl.ts DESC
    ) AS rn_last
  FROM non_charging_windows pw
  JOIN signal_log sl
    ON sl.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
   AND sl.field = 'BatteryLevel'
   AND sl.value_kind = 5
   AND sl.ts >= pw.started_at
   AND sl.ts <= pw.ended_at
   AND sl.float_value IS NOT NULL
),
raw_events AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END) AS start_battery_pct,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) AS end_battery_pct
  FROM battery_samples
  GROUP BY started_at, ended_at
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END)
         - MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) >= 0
),
vampire_events AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    start_battery_pct,
    end_battery_pct,
    start_battery_pct - end_battery_pct AS drain_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
    (start_battery_pct - end_battery_pct)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 3600.0, 0)
      AS drain_pct_per_hour
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE ended_at > started_at
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(drain_pct_per_hour)::numeric, 2) AS "Drain %/hr"
FROM vampire_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Phantom Drain Rate
panels.description: Average battery percentage lost per hour in completed, unplugged parked windows with battery samples at both endpoints.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered_states AS (
  SELECT
    ts AS started_at,
    LEAD(ts, 1, $__timeTo()) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS ended_at,
    to_state
  FROM fsm_transitions
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND fsm_name = 'vehicle'
    AND ts <= $__timeTo()
),
state_durations AS (
  SELECT
    to_state,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAST(ended_at, $__timeTo()) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom())
    )) / 3600.0 AS hours
  FROM ordered_states
  WHERE ended_at > $__timeFrom()
    AND started_at < $__timeTo()
)
SELECT to_state AS "State", ROUND(SUM(hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Hours"
FROM state_durations
WHERE hours > 0
GROUP BY to_state
ORDER BY "Hours" DESC

panels.description: Recorded time in each vehicle-FSM state, reconstructed from consecutive transitions and clipped to the dashboard time range.

battery_samples AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pw.started_at, pw.ended_at ORDER BY sl.ts DESC
    ) AS rn_last
  FROM non_charging_windows pw
  JOIN signal_log sl
    ON sl.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
   AND sl.field = 'BatteryLevel'
   AND sl.value_kind = 5
   AND sl.ts >= pw.started_at
   AND sl.ts <= pw.ended_at
   AND sl.float_value IS NOT NULL
),
raw_events AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END) AS start_battery_pct,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) AS end_battery_pct
  FROM battery_samples
  GROUP BY started_at, ended_at
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) IS NOT NULL
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN battery_level END)
         - MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN battery_level END) >= 0
),
vampire_events AS (
  SELECT
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    start_battery_pct,
    end_battery_pct,
    start_battery_pct - end_battery_pct AS drain_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
    (start_battery_pct - end_battery_pct)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 3600.0, 0)
      AS drain_pct_per_hour
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE ended_at > started_at
)
SELECT
  started_at AS "Start",
  ended_at AS "End",
  ROUND(duration_hours::numeric, 1) AS "Hours",
  ROUND(start_battery_pct::numeric, 1) AS "Start SOC %",
  ROUND(end_battery_pct::numeric, 1) AS "End SOC %",
  ROUND(drain_pct::numeric, 1) AS "Lost %",
  ROUND(drain_pct_per_hour::numeric, 2) AS "Drain %/hr"
FROM vampire_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 100
